name: Ise Kahoru
source:
One of the twins under Tatebayashi's command. 
His younger brother, Kaoru, suffered serious injuries in a recent accident and is still undergoing treatment. 
He belongs to one of the fourteen families of Shinto priests who can see and control spirits, but because he serves Tatebayashi, he is treated poorly by his fellow families of Shinto priests.

"This is indeed a sound argument. However, citizen, it's very impudent to express your opinion without knowing the reality. I'll teach the reality to you."
